defective_pattern: Arbitrarily pruning or truncating calculated demographic/clinical variables from reporting scope or substituting comprehensive calculation ledgers with truncated stubs.
why_defective: Leads to incomplete empirical reporting and violates full disclosure principles required by APA 7 and stage triad invariants.
observed_symptoms: Missing demographic variables in the final report.
Truncated stubs used instead of full demographics_calculated.json ledger.
corrective_remedy: Preserve and pass the full calculation ledger (`demographics_calculated.json`) and exhaustively report all empirical variables in the Stage 4D.1 triad.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detecting omission of variables present in demographics_calculated.json within the generated markdown or docx.
